message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **10 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time) when both cities are observing daylight‑saving time.  
- During standard time (winter) the offset is **9 hours** (Berlin +1, Los Angeles –8).  
- When daylight‑saving is in effect (summer) the offset becomes **10 hours** (Berlin +2, Los Angeles –7).  

Because daylight‑saving periods differ slightly between the U.S. and Europe, the exact difference can shift by an hour when one country switches and the other has not yet done so.
